composition_variation: Paint Bond the large fluffy white dog resting on a soft cushion beneath a moonlit window. Preserve his distinctive dark paws and gentle sleepy eyes, with no other characters or animals. Use thick soft brushwork, velvety navy shadows, a warm honey-colored floor lamp, and subtle silver fur highlights. Frame his face and front paws in the lower central area for an inviting cozy portrait. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
